name: flux-messenger
description: Flux Messenger - Real-time messaging with WebRTC (full-stack single service)

scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
